content:
Later test runs were more successful as effects were dampened and proper care was taken to add additional insulation to all testing and monitoring equipment.

Note: Despite its much later discovery and development, the "Grounded" serum trials proved extremely helpful in finalizing this serum, as test subjects could be placed in close proximity to observe interactions.”— The Whitespring Bunker terminal entries
**Electrically Charged** is a mutation in *Fallout 76*.
